notes.title: New Content Update Soon!
notes.notes:
Version 0.5.0!

FLOODED FORTRESS (Level 8)
A new enemy is being added to Flooded Fortress

Changed how a song variant of Flooded Fortress is triggered

Added some new content to Flooded Fortress


CONTENT
Small content additions throughout the game

Small aesthetic changes or additions throughout the game

Small rebalances to challenges throughout the game


BUG FIXES
Removed the ledge grab/water entrance collision glitch that got a lot of people stuck

Fixed some collision bugs throughout the game, specifically a consistent collision bug in Calcium Catacombs (Level 7)

Fixed some framerate issues throughout the gams

Fixed some grammar and spelling

Other miscellaneous fixes


Thank you to all the new players who got the game this week!
